title: Pagasa sees rains over northern Luzon, fair weather across rest of PH

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The northeast monsoon or amihan will bring rains in parts of northern Luzon, while the rest of the country will see fair weather conditions with chances of thunderstorms due to easterlies on Saturday, according to the weather bureau. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), weather specialist Veronica Torres-Bagalanon said that no low pressure areas or tropical cyclones are being monitored inside and outside the Philippine area of responsibility.
